--- stdout
usage: codebreaker teeth [options] <module>

break functions the judge passed, on purpose: does it notice?

Break functions the judge has passed, one small way each, and see whether it notices.

arguments:
  module  a corpus name or a file

options:
      --rounds N   rounds of breaks (each function is broken once) (default: 3)
      --json FILE  where the report is written (default: the report folder, named after the module)
  -h, --help       show this help
